description: Newcastle's recorded manifest debt - the CITY-OWNED half of tests/check_manifest.py. Each rule's paths are the exact rows that fail it; `ceiling` is their count and may only FALL. Adding a path fails unless the ceiling is raised in the same change with a new ceiling_log entry carrying the date, the reason and `"raised": true` - an explicit, dated, reasoned raise is the only way the ceiling goes up; a listed path that no longer fails must be deleted and the ceiling lowered. A city with no file carries no debt.

raw_without_retrieved.reason: A raw file that is not a provenance record and carries no retrieval date of its own. Measured 25 September 2026 when the rule was introduced; provenance_*.json records were exempted by rule on 29 September 2026 (each carries its own dated retrieval key, which check_manifest.py now verifies), which removed them from this list.

ceiling_log.reason: measured against the committed manifest when the rule was introduced
data/raw/provenance_smvu.json added to the list in d7d93b31 while it had no count; recorded here so the history is whole
provenance_*.json exempt by rule: a provenance record IS the retrieval record, and its own dated retrieval key is now verified instead

processed_without_source.reason: A derived row whose ancestry holds no raw download: the C1 parameter files are generated from the registry (9.32) and the per-scenario vehicles.xml from the mode vehicle fields, so no declared source and no provenance record covers them. Measured 8 October 2026 when the rule was introduced (sixteenth report). Leaves when the manifest can name the registry as a source.
